explanationMd: Factor out perfect squares: √72 = √(36 × 2) = 6√2 and √8 = √(4 × 2) = 2√2. Their difference is 4√2. Combining radicals requires like radical parts, not subtracting the numbers under the roots.

distractorRationale.d: A difference of square roots is not generally the root of a difference.
distractorRationale.a: This adds the simplified coefficients instead of subtracting.
distractorRationale.e: This fails to extract the full square factor from 72.
distractorRationale.c: The remaining factor √2 does not disappear.
